sources.entry: CamiTune - System-wide audio equalizer for macOS(13+) with parametric EQ, per-app audio control, Auto EQ, AU/VST3 plugin support, and advanced DSP. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Shuail135/CamiTune) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: CamiTune is a native macOS app (macOS 13+) for system-wide audio tuning, combining parametric EQ, per-app volume/EQ, device-specific profiles, and Auto EQ, built on CamillaDSP.
summary.what_it_does: CamiTune applies system-wide equalization on macOS, with a parametric EQ of up to 20 bands that can import Equalizer APO text files, plus simple bass, mid and treble controls. It offers per-app volume, mute and EQ, with menu bar control that also shows whether CamiTune is active. Output profiles store separate settings per physical output, including sample rate, buffer size, DSP settings and AU/VST3 plug-in chains, and can activate by physical device, selected device, or manually. Device correction includes Auto EQ for headphones, IEMs and speakers, room correction (beta) using a calibrated or uncalibrated microphone, FIR filter support, headphone crossfeed and per-channel processing. A guided setup installs and verifies the bundled System Audio Bridge driver. The README states it uses no analytics and submits no logs.
use_cases: equalize all system audio on a Mac
tune headphones or IEMs with auto EQ
set different EQ per output device
control volume and EQ for individual apps
load AU or VST3 plug-ins into system audio
correct a room's acoustics with a microphone
how_to_run: Download CamiTune-v0.x.x-app.zip from the repository's Releases page
Extract the archive and move CamiTune.app into Applications
Attempt to open the app once, then approve it in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway
Run the guided setup and select Install / Repair to install the drivers
Build from source: install full Xcode (Swift 5.9 is used by the project)
stack: BlackHole (modified, output-only derivative for System Audio Bridge)
notable: Remembers separate settings per audio device and switches profiles automatically
Per-app volume, mute and EQ with menu bar control
Auto EQ for headphones, IEMs and speakers, plus room correction with calibrated or uncalibrated microphones
Imports Equalizer APO text files into an editable parametric EQ
Designed to stay lightweight when the window is closed and the app sits in the menu bar
caveats: Requires macOS 13 Ventura or newer; the README says macOS 13 cannot support the planned Core Audio tap feature
Releases are not Developer ID signed, so macOS blocks the first launch and needs manual approval
Plug-in support is marked Beta, and room correction is also Beta
Does not detect or disable other system-EQ applications
Speaker Auto EQ fetches measurement data at runtime from the Spinorama API
